options.name: auth
options.setting-help: the page's auth: the bearer token the browser presents — the `?auth=<token>` query bootstraps the session cookie

options.name: auth-token
options.setting-help: require Authorization: Bearer <token> on the page, config.js and the proxy — mandatory beyond loopback; the `?auth=<token>` query bootstraps the session cookie; startup-only (pass it by flag/env/config); the value never renders back (`file:<path>` = the token from an owner-only file)
options.help: require Authorization: Bearer <token> on the page, config.js and the proxy — mandatory beyond loopback (a token-less non-loopback bind refuses to start, F21); a request carrying `?auth=<token>` bootstraps an HttpOnly session cookie, the raw Bearer header is accepted too; the value may be `file:<path>` — the first line of an owner-only 0600 file (a systemd LoadCredential rides as file:/run/credentials/...)

options.name: control-port
options.help: JSON-lines control server target: unix socket path or TCP port number on 127.0.0.1 (e.g. 15598); 0 = off. Talk to it with dashboard-ctl.py

options.name: control-ops-token
options.setting-help: a second, read-only control token: sessions authenticating with it may run its policy's verbs only (the default policy: show) (no set/clear, no request reload, no shutdown) — the ops shift against the admin key, both audited (`file:<path>` = the token from an owner-only file)
options.help: a second, read-only control token: sessions authenticating with it may run its policy's verbs only (the default policy: show) (no set/clear, no request reload, no shutdown) — the ops shift against the admin key, both audited; the value may be `file:<path>` — the first line of an owner-only 0600 file (a systemd LoadCredential rides as file:/run/credentials/...)

options.name: metrics-server
options.setting-help: the dashboard's own Prometheus /metrics endpoint (needs a token beyond loopback; the address is --metrics-listen)
options.help: serve the dashboard's own Prometheus /metrics endpoint (the uptime, the request counters, the proxied query total, the client gate) — off unless toggled (the live `set metrics enable` toggle), and a token is mandatory beyond loopback (a token-less non-loopback bind refuses to start, F13)

options.name: metrics-listen

options.help: the metrics bind address HOST:PORT

options.name: metrics-token

options.name: audit-log
options.setting-help: DSH audit trail: a file path or - for stdout (the docker/journald way); `none` = no local file (the forward carries the trail); the XDG state home when unset
options.help: DSH audit trail: a file path or - for stdout (the docker/journald way); `none` turns the local file off (with a forward spelled that is the remote-only mode); the XDG state home (~/.local/state/dashboard/audit.log) when unset

options.name: audit-forward
options.help: also forward the DSH audit trail: syslog (the local socket auto-scan), syslog:/path (an explicit socket), udp://host[:514] (RFC5426, best-effort) or tcp://host[:514] (RFC6587 framing) — the off-box copy carries the per-writer hash chain, so a scheduled search at the collector can alert on a chain break; docs/AUDIT.md

options.name: audit

options.name: dump-path
options.help: the state dump: the live setting overrides (the toggles, the caps, the log surface — the tokens apart) as one JSON, written 0600 with an integrity hash (a restore refuses a tampered, unsigned or group-writable dump); dumped on the request dump command, the graceful shutdown and every --dump-interval seconds; loaded on start only with --restore-on-start, on demand with the request restore command

options.name: restore-on-start
options.help: load the state dump when the server starts (needs --dump-path) — the live overrides ride again instead of a cold start; without it the dump loads on demand

show.name: connections

show.name: metrics-acl-table
show.setting-help: the metrics ACL as its rule chain, one entry per line (the metrics/acl report)
